product_one_liner.value: CoLab provides an AI-powered collaborative design-review workspace for mechanical engineering and hardware-development teams, capturing engineering knowledge to help them make better, faster design decisions.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was visible in the navigation or footer. The pricing URL displays demo/contact content rather than pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: CoLab explicitly identifies both manufacturers as users of its design-review software.

employee_band.notes: CoLab's job posting describes a team of 250+.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by engineer and CTO Jeremy Andrews discuss CoLab's geometry-analysis/LLM approach to DFM and its AI/CAD review approach, including company-context retrieval.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains numerous articles, including viewing 3D models, comparing file revisions, and participating in reviews.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open posting: Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Anthropic; Amazon Web Services; Google Cloud; Microsoft Azure
model_provider.notes: Each is explicitly listed as an LLM provider; the subprocessor list does not specify individual model versions.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center specifically lists SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022.

last_funding.notes: The date is the public announcement month: November 10, 2025. No separate closing date is specified in the announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The $72 million Series C announcement on November 10, 2025 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open posting: Key Account Executive – Aerospace & Defense.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 30, 2026, CoLab announced the release of generative artifacts, within the requested six-month window. The separate generative CAD product was only planned for H1 2027.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 6, 2026, CoLab announced Tom Greever joining as SVP of Design and Jessie Wheeler joining as SVP of Operations, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Operations Systems posting names these tools. It groups Salesloft/Outreach together, so this is a stack signal rather than confirmation that both are deployed.
